November 21, 41.

Dear Sir,

In reply to your letter dated November
15, 1941, I forward herewith copy of Police report
regarding M. Sternberg, S.V. Sternberg, G. Roberts
and S.M. Hashim.

Yours faithfully,

W Duncan
Assistant Commissioner
(Special Branch).

American Consulate-General,
SHANGHAI.

Original sent on 21/11/41

AM. CONS. GEN.
